title: Room Reservations Cancellation Deadline Table
content:
These are the deadline figures of each Room Reservations rate plan: whether the plan can be cancelled without penalty at all, how many calendar days before the arrival date the free-cancellation deadline falls at most hotels and at resort-brand hotels, the hotel local clock time on the deadline date, and whether redeemed points come back on a cancellation on or before the deadline.

| Rate plan | Free cancellation possible | Deadline days before arrival (most hotels) | Deadline days before arrival (Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve) | Clock time on the deadline date (hotel local) | Redeemed points returned on a cancellation on or before the deadline |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | No | 0 | 0 | 23:59 | No |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | Yes | 3 | 7 | 23:59 | No |
| Flexible Rate | Yes | 1 | 3 | 23:59 | No |
| Member Flexible Rate | Yes | 1 | 3 | 23:59 | No |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | Yes | 1 | 3 | 23:59 | No |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | Yes | 0 | 2 | 18:00 | No |
| Group Block Rate | Yes | 3 | 7 | 23:59 | No |
| Reward Night Rate | Yes | 2 | 3 | 23:59 | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Deadline days (most hotels)** are calendar days before the arrival date on which the free-cancellation deadline falls; 0 means the arrival date itself.
- **Deadline days (resort brands)** are the calendar days that apply instead when the hotel's brand is Ashbury Resort & Spa or Ashbury Reserve.
- **Clock time** is the hotel local time on the deadline date by which the cancellation must be recorded.
- **Redeemed points returned** states whether points redeemed for the reservation are returned when it is cancelled on or before the deadline.

## Reading the table

| Question | Answer from the table |
|---|---|
| Which plan has no free cancellation at all? | The Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate. |
| Which plan's deadline falls on the arrival date itself at most hotels? | The Corporate Negotiated Rate (0 days, 18:00) — and, nominally, the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, which allows no free cancellation in any case. |
| Which plan uses a clock time other than 23:59? | Only the Corporate Negotiated Rate, at 18:00. |
| Which plans have the longest resort-brand deadline? | The Semi-Flexible Saver Rate and the Group Block Rate, 7 days before arrival. |
| Which plan returns redeemed points on a timely cancellation? | Only the Reward Night Rate. |

Hypothetical illustration of the figures: for a Member Flexible Rate reservation arriving on a 20th, the deadline date is the 19th at most hotels (1 day before) and the 17th at an Ashbury Resort & Spa (3 days before), at 23:59 hotel local time in both cases.
